author: Lucas Valbuena

papers.title: Collatz basin densities and canonical traces from first-passage stabilization
papers.main_result: For one fixed positive integer K_seed and every positive target N prime to three, shortcut and ordinary predecessor natural densities are at least 3/(128*K_seed*N).
papers.credit: The inverse-linear form was proposed by Wirsching. The proof uses Mazur's weighted predecessor construction and Said Duran's coalescence theorem, alongside the density and canonical-limit foundations described in the paper.
papers.additional_results: Uniform exact first-hit coefficient bound at positive odd targets, including periodic targets; actual finite cylinder-mass transport and energy decomposition; an exact finite-energy criterion equivalent to universal eventual periodicity, with unconditional normalized decay outside every diverging ancestor barrier. Unconditional raw occupation lower bound: for every b<1/log(4/3), the sum of actual weighted first-hit densities over odd N≤R is at least b log R for all sufficiently large integer R.

manuscript.scope: Parent semantic review of the sixteen new sources and integrated proof; final PDF review; preservation of all 28 previous statements and proofs and the earlier formal bundles; package and fresh-artifact verification. Automated review is not external peer review.

native_foundation.scope: Recorded audit with authenticated exact dependency-closure reuse and a freshly compiled root audit. The current distribution preserves all 1602 pinned source hashes.

periodic_census_extension.scope: All 51 supplied application modules freshly compiled and individually kernel-replayed. All compiled constants, including private and generated constants, audited. Required native dependencies authenticated before and after the run. Pinned native and library caches reused; the full upstream closure was not freshly rebuilt.

finite_cylinder_energy_extension.scope: All 17 bundled application modules and their generated whole-module audit were freshly compiled and individually kernel-replayed. All application constants, including private and generated constants, were audited. Required periodic-census (40) and native (1566) objects were reused after pinned source/object/import and dependency-fingerprint authentication before and after. Pinned Mathlib/Lean caches were reused; this is not a fresh rebuild of the entire upstream closure.

raw_occupation_extension.scope: All 16 bundled application modules and their generated whole-module audit were freshly compiled and individually kernel-replayed. All 153 compiled constants, including private and generated constants, were audited. Exactly 913 required native objects were reused after source/object/import and dependency-fingerprint authentication before and after. Pinned Mathlib/Lean caches were reused; this is not a fresh rebuild of the entire upstream closure. No periodic-census or cylinder-energy application objects are used.

limitations: Sublinear masked cylinder energy, equivalently universal eventual periodicity, remains unresolved. The equivalence does not exclude additional cycles.
The raw occupation lower bound supplies no matching raw upper bound or convergence of the normalized sum; it does not exclude divergent orbits.
The lower-bound constants are fixed Lean choices; no numerical value or uniform finite-cutoff estimate is asserted.
Novelty comparisons and automated semantic reviews are not external peer review or an exhaustive priority search.
Verification scope is stated per record; source/object authentication is distinguished from fresh compilation and individual kernel replay.
